description_en: Specifies manageable projects in a project authorization. This operation can be called only when the ScopeType parameter returned by the GetProjectAuthorization operation is 2 for the corresponding project authorization
description_zh: 在项目授权中指定可管理的项目。仅当通过GetProjectAuthorization接口获取到的对应项目授权中ScopeType参数返回值为2时可调用本接口
name: AttachProjectsToProjectAuthorization

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The project authorization ID.
You can call the ListProjectAuthorizations operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
项目授权ID。
您可以调用ListProjectAuthorizations接口获取该参数
parameters.name: authorization_id

parameters.help_en:
The array of IDs of the projects that can be managed.
You can call the ListProjects operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定可管理的项目ID数组。
您可以调用ListProjects接口获取该参数
parameters.name: project_ids

RequestId.description_en: The request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
